sitrep.summary: 4 satellite passes processed since the sinking on 25 May 2025 (2 usable, 2 clouded). DriftSight has flagged 7 candidate debris patches; 2 are confirmed because they re-appeared where the currents predicted, and no look-alikes have been rejected yet. The pellet forecast puts 86% of the simulated nurdles ashore by this time.
sitrep.landfall_line: Thiruvananthapuram 70% (first 27 May) · Kanyakumari 16% (first 29 May) · Kollam 2% (first 27 May) · Ramanathapuram 0% (first 7 Jun). Forecast first arrival at Kanyakumari 29 May, 04:00 IST, consistent with the 30 May beach survey that rated pellet pollution “Very High”.

sitrep.method: Detection: per-pixel classifier on Sentinel-2 bands with FDI/NDVI. Tracking: ensemble particle drift with Bayesian confirmation at each pass. Prototype uses synthetic imagery and a synthetic monsoon circulation; production uses Sentinel-2/Landsat/Sentinel-1, INCOIS/CMEMS currents and ERA5 winds.
sitrep.caveat: Prototype. Detection imagery and ocean fields in this report are simulated; no figure here is a measurement. Production sources: Sentinel-2 / Landsat / Sentinel-1 imagery, INCOIS and CMEMS currents, ERA5 winds.
